packageRules.description: Hold Vitest on 4.x: the Workers test pool @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.2.x peers on vitest ^4.1.0 and does not start under Vitest 5. Remove this rule once Vitest 5 support ships (https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/15500, tracked in https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/issues/15618) and bump vitest together with @cloudflare/vitest-plugin.
